items.quote: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
items.claim: God instructs Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy elders of Israel to come before the LORD and worship at a distance.
items.object: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, seventy of the elders of Israel
